text:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty alert INC-2026-1899 triggered -> elevated 5xx rate on api-gateway-prod. severity: SEV2. auto-paging oncall.
olivia: i'm oncall, paging infra. seeing large 5xx spike across /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings. spike started ~4m after a config rollout. overall 5xx ~15% for last 3 minutes.
mike: on it. pulling envoy stats and loadbalancer counters now.
sanjay: joining the thread — I'll help with config checks and circuit-breakers.
olivia: customer impact: intermittent 503/504 for a subset of enterprise customers on dedicated clusters, some user-facing timeouts.
mike: logs -> upstream reset, connection failures. envoy stats: upstream_rq_5xx=1340, upstream_rq_timeout=420, upstream_cx_overflow increase on hostset-a.
deploy-bot: Config rollout cfg-2026-11 deployed 4 minutes ago: changed retry attempts from 1 -> 2 on /v1/* routes.
olivia: that change + current connection usage could be compounding. retries can amplify load if upstreams are struggling.
mike: checking route-level circuit_breakers: route "svc/generate" max_connections=100 but current cx_active reported ~180 on several pods. overflow behavior is causing resets -> 5xx.
sanjay: yep. retry storm + low max_connections = resource exhaustion. quick mitigation: remove retries and increase max_connections, also consider shifting traffic away from the impacted hostset.
olivia: agree. plan: 1) disable retries on gateway for 60s, 2) increase route max_connections to 300, 3) shift 30% weight to secondary region, 4) monitor 10m then revert/PR. who can apply?
mike: I can push the rollback. running dry-run then apply.
mike: running:
```
# dry-run
orchctl rollout --config cfg-2026-11 --dry-run
# apply minimal change
orchctl patch envoy-config --route svc/generate --set retries=0 --set circuit_breakers.max_connections=300
```

mike: applied patch to gateway canary. removing retries now.

mike: metrics: after removal, upstream_rq_5xx -> trending down (15% -> 6% within 45s). latency also dropping.
luis: graphs in Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/xyz/incidents?panelId=7 showing 5xx drop. saving snapshots to /mnt/incidents/1954321000.
pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by olivia.
tara: customer comms: notifying affected enterprise support channels. ETA for stabilization 15m.

olivia: quick note — also saw increased socket pending queues on dedicated nodes, might need kernel tunable review (somaxconn, net.core.somaxconn). add to follow up.
sanjay: for immediate safety i'll shift 30% traffic to secondary region via weight adjustment on LB. doing weight change now.
sanjay: executed weight shift: primary 70% -> secondary 30%. traffic rebalanced.
mike: after weight shift + retries disabled, 5xx down to ~2.1% in last 2 minutes.
olivia: good. mike, open a rollback PR to permanently revert the retry bump and add canary gating. sanjay, please own follow-up on connection pool sizing and CB defaults.
mike: PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/infra/PR-881 revert cfg-2026-11 and add canary checks.
sanjay: creating a follow-up RFC for connection pooling + envoy upstream config: RFC-2026-44, assigning to eng-runtime.

deploy-bot: Rollback applied: cfg-2026-11 -> reverted (retries restored to 1). change id: rollback-1954321000.
luis: saving collector logs: /mnt/incidents/1954321000/envoy-stats.log and /mnt/incidents/1954321000/upstream-traces.json
tara: sent initial customer notice to priority queue and enterprise reps, subject: Brief service interruption affecting api-gateway (now stabilizing).
olivia: handing over on-call for incident to sanjay for next 2 hours — i've got another urgent engagement. please monitor 5xx, latency, and cpu/mem on dedicated nodes.
sanjay: taking over. immediate next steps: watch for recurrence for 30m, schedule kernel tunables review, and coordinate with product on rollback PR testing.
mike: will add autoscaling note: may need to increase pool size temporarily when retry changes happen.
olivia: postmortem notes (brief): suspected root cause = aggressive retry increase in cfg-2026-11 combined with low per-route max_connections -> retry amplification -> upstream connection exhaustion -> 5xx and timeouts. mitigation = rollback retries, increase max_connections, shift weight, and monitor. action items: revert config (mike), RFC for connection pooling (sanjay), add canary gating to retries changes (mike), add observability alert for upstream_cx_overflow (luis).
luis: attaching key graphs and the audit diff for cfg-2026-11 to the incident folder.
pagerduty-bot: Incident status changed to stable (acknowledged -> stable) by sanjay.
sanjay: i'll keep monitoring for 1 hour then update postmortem. handing off to oncall rotation for normal ops after that.
olivia: thanks everyone. great quick coordination. :thumbsup:
mike: thumbs.
